japanese: 上には上がある
kana: うえにはうえがある
meanings: greatness is comparative
there is always someone better than you

japanese: 上手の手から水が漏れる
kana: じょうずのてからみずがもれる
meanings: anyone can make a mistake
even Homer nods

japanese: 情けが仇
kana: なさけがあだ
meanings: Pardon makes offenders

japanese: 色事は思案の外
kana: いろごとはしあんのほか
meanings: love and reason do not go together

japanese: 触らぬ神に祟りなし
kana: さわらぬかみにたたりなし
meanings: let sleeping dogs lie
wake not a sleeping lion

japanese: 寝る子は育つ
kana: ねるこはそだつ
meanings: sleep brings up a child well
a well-slept child is a well-kept child

japanese: 寝るほど楽はなかりけり
kana: ねるほどらくはなかりけり
meanings: there is nothing better than sleeping

japanese: 心焉に在らざれば視れども見えず
kana: こころここにあらざればみれどもみえず
meanings: the eye is blind if the mind is absent

japanese: 新しい酒は古い革袋に入れる
kana: あたらしいさけはふるいかわぶくろにいれる
meanings: to put new wine into old wineskins
to put new wine into old bottles

japanese: 深い川は静かに流れる
kana: ふかいかわはしずかにながれる
meanings: still waters run deep

japanese: 親に似ぬ子は鬼子
kana: おやににぬこはおにご
meanings: like father, like son
a child who does not resemble their parents is a changeling

japanese: 親の因果が子に報う
kana: おやのいんががこにむくう
meanings: the sins of the father shall be visited upon the son

japanese: 親の光は七光り
kana: おやのひかりはななひかり
meanings: having a famous parent is the best way to fame

japanese: 親はなくても子は育つ
kana: おやはなくてもこはそだつ
meanings: nature itself is a good mother
even without parents, children grow up

japanese: 親見たけりゃ子を見ろ
kana: おやみたけりゃこをみろ
meanings: like father, like son

japanese: 身を捨ててこそ浮かぶ瀬もあれ
kana: みをすててこそうかぶせもあれ
meanings: nothing ventured, nothing gained

japanese: 人の噂も七十五日
kana: ひとのうわさもしちじゅうごにち
meanings: a wonder lasts but nine days
gossip lasts just 75 days

japanese: 人の口に戸は立てられず
kana: ひとのくちにとはたてられず
meanings: people will talk

japanese: 人のふり見てわがふり直せ
kana: ひとのふりみてわがふりなおせ
meanings: one man's fault is another's lesson

japanese: 人の蠅を追うより己の蠅を追え
kana: ひとのはえをおうよりおのれのはえをおえ
meanings: take care of yourself before you take care of others
wave off your own flies before you wave off someone else's flies

japanese: 人はパンのみにて生くる者に非ず
kana: ひとはパンのみにていくるものにあらず
meanings: man shall not live by bread alone

japanese: 人は一代名は末代
kana: ひとはいちだいなはまつだい
meanings: the worthy will be remembered
humans (last) one generation; names (last) forever

japanese: 人は見かけによらぬもの
kana: ひとはみかけによらぬもの
meanings: appearances can be deceiving
don't judge a book by its cover

japanese: 人は情け
kana: ひとはなさけ
meanings: be kind to others
one good turn deserves another

japanese: 人を怨むより身を怨め
kana: ひとをうらむよりみをうらめ
meanings: it is easier to blame than do better
instead of resenting others, resent yourself
